title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI was backdoored with a credential stealer
altText: Animated illustration with the headline 'Can one pip install steal your API keys?' and the line 'A poisoned LiteLLM update did it this week.' A developer types 'pip install litellm' and the terminal says 'installed 1.107.0'. A box labelled 'litellm v1.107.0' drops in, its lid pops open and a masked thief climbs out. Gold keys fly from the developer's laptop to a cloud labelled 'hacker's server' while the developer frowns. A card on the floor reads 'Safer: pin a version you checked: pip install litellm==1.106.2'.
